lng.verdict: REPLACE: four national regulators / operators (TH ERC, MY Suruhanjaya Tenaga, SG EMA-SLNG, ID Arun) publish per-energy terminal tariffs; independent, convertible (full-utilisation tariff per MWh, the basis of the registered adder); value = median of the country groups
lng.caveat: the published tariffs are full-cost (capacity charge incl. capital recovery); the model also charges the expansion capex 8,020 EUR2020/MW/a on NEW terminal capacity (~0.92 EUR/MWh at full use) - the capital part is counted twice on expanded capacity (as for the old 1.26); open question

co2_ship.verdict: KEEP + RANGE: the literature gives chain totals at single distances with different pressure levels (7 barg low pressure vs the 100 bar chain of IEAGHG 2004), inlet conditions (pre-pressurised) and ship sizes; the split into a distance-independent part and a per-km slope is a derivation (OLS / model slope), not a source value. IEAGHG 2020 and BEIS 2018 share the lead consultancy. Model chain at 1,000 km (14.37 EUR2020/t) lies inside the literature spread (BEIS lower, IEAGHG / ZEP higher). Fixed part range and slope range registered
